name: wrong_grouping
description: Groups by currency only; no per-employee ranking.

execution.sql:
SELECT c.currency_code, SUM(c.amount) AS total_spend
FROM card_transactions AS c
JOIN employees AS e ON c.employee_id = e.employee_id
WHERE c.transaction_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
GROUP BY c.currency_code
ORDER BY total_spend DESC

findings.description: groups by currency, so employees are not ranked
findings.observed_behavior: groups by currency, so employees are not ranked
